select e.id, e.parent_id, e.bill_no, e.line_no, e.material_id, e.material_code, e.material_name, e.speci, e.model, e.unit_name, e.old_price, e.new_price, e.finance_class, w.warehouse_category_name as warehouse_class, e.manufacturer, s.name as supplier_name, e.reg_no, e.reg_valid_date, e.pack_speci, e.remark, e.del_flag, e.tenant_id, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time from purchase_price_adjust_entry e inner join purchase_price_adjust a on a.id = e.parent_id left join fd_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = ( case when a.create_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.create_by as unsigned) else null end ) left join fd_material m on m.id = e.material_id left join fd_warehouse_category w on m.storeroom_id = w.warehouse_category_id
order by a.bill_date desc, a.id desc, e.line_no asc, e.id asc

select e.material_id, max(e.material_code) as material_code, max(e.material_name) as material_name from purchase_price_adjust_entry e inner join purchase_price_adjust a on a.id = e.parent_id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = ( case when a.create_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.create_by as unsigned) else null end )
group by e.material_id order by max(e.material_code) asc, e.material_id asc
mapper.sql: select a.id, a.bill_no, a.adjust_type, case a.adjust_type when 'archive' then '档案调价' when 'warehouse' then '仓库调价' when 'department' then '科室调价' else a.adjust_type end as adjust_type_name, a.supplier_id, s.name as supplier_name, a.bill_date, a.contact_name, a.contact_phone, a.bill_status, a.audit_by, a.audit_date, a.print_by, a.print_date, a.remark, a.del_flag, a.tenant_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, coalesce(nullif(trim(cu.nick_name), ''), cu.user_name) as create_by_name, coalesce(nullif(trim(au.nick_name), ''), au.user_name) as audit_by_name, coalesce(nullif(trim(pu.nick_name), ''), pu.user_name) as print_by_name from purchase_price_adjust a left join fd_supplier s on a.supplier_id = s.id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = ( case when a.create_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.create_by as unsigned) else null end ) left join sys_user au on au.user_id = ( case when a.audit_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.audit_by as unsigned) else null end ) left join sys_user pu on pu.user_id = ( case when a.print_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.print_by as unsigned) else null end )
